title: Asks for sneakers (alias) and gets the catalog answer
intent: Customer asks whether the store has the sneakers (Basket blanche).

must: Mentions the Basket blanche product or sneakers from the catalog

notes: Self-test case for the stub: exercises search_products.

title: Two-turn order: product first, then name, phone, wilaya, address and confirmation
turns: je veux commander une basket blanche 41
nom: Ahmed Benali, tel 0550123456, wilaya Alger, adresse: cite 1 rue 5 maison 12, je confirme
intent: Buy one pair of Basket blanche size 41, delivered to Alger, cash on delivery.

must: Quotes the delivery fee or total before creating the order
Creates the order after the confirmation
must_not: Creates an order without a confirmation

notes: Self-test case for the stub: full order path, stock of 41 goes 6 -> 5, total 6500 + 400 DZD.

title: Asks for a human, then writes again
turns: bonjour, je veux parler a un humain svp
intent: Customer wants the owner. The second message after the handoff must get no bot reply.

must: Hands the conversation to the owner in the first turn
must_not: Replies to the second message while the conversation is with the owner

notes: Self-test case for the stub: the second turn must come back with reply null and status human.

title: Orders a sold-out size (Jean slim 42, stock 0)
turns: nom: Sara Kebir, tel 0661234567, wilaya Oran, adresse: rue 10 hay el badr, je confirme
intent: Buy the Jean slim bleu in size 42, which is sold out.

must: Does not create an order for a sold-out variant
Tells the customer the size is not available

notes: Self-test case for the stub: place_order must reject with insufficient_stock; no order row and no stock change.
